name: Envision Chifeng Zero-Carbon Industrial Park AIDC
notes: China Securities Journal reported the Chifeng zero-carbon industrial park includes an AIDC powered by a 2GW wind/solar/storage renewable system, described as an industry first for 100% green-power direct supply.

name: Aohan Banner Guoyi Intelligent Computing Center
developer: Chifeng Guoyi Digital Technology Co., Ltd.
notes: Reported as a filed/approved intelligent computing center in Aohan Banner with planned 1,500P FP16 compute, including 1,000P NVIDIA-card compute; total investment reported above RMB 1.4 billion.

name: Chuangxing Technology Chifeng Computing Center
notes: Filing reported for a RMB 100 million project at Chifeng New Materials Industrial Park; planned 16,474 sqm two-story data center building, 1,500 servers, and four 2,000 kVA transformers, construction period 2025-02 to 2026-02.

name: Hinggan League Government Cloud / Local Private Cloud and Disaster Recovery Centers
developer: Hinggan League government / China Mobile / Huawei cloud resources
notes: Official Hinggan League response says the league government cloud platform was substantially completed, with a Hohhot-Horinger remote hybrid cloud as primary, a Hinggan local private cloud as auxiliary, and disaster-recovery centers at both sites. AII case material says a Huawei cloud pool expanded in 2018 was dedicated to the Hinggan League cloud data center project.

name: Huawei Cloud Horinger Data Center
notes: People's Daily reported the Horinger project started construction in 2023 with west/south/north areas, about 5,963 mu, 50 data-center buildings and six 220 kV substations. A 2025 government news item says Huawei Cloud Horinger was among five major projects lit and operating.

name: China Mobile Intelligent Computing Center (Hohhot)
notes: Xinhua describes the facility in the Horinger data-center cluster as the world's largest single-building liquid-cooled intelligent computing center among telecom operators, with 67 exaflops-class FP operations per second reported in Chinese notation.

name: China Mobile Hohhot Data Center B17-B18 Computer Room Buildings
notes: Filing reported June 2026 for RMB 650 million in new B17-B18 buildings inside China Mobile Hohhot Data Center, about 82,000 sqm, planned construction 2026-06 to 2027-12.

name: China Telecom Inner Mongolia Cloud Computing Information Park
notes: Horinger cluster reporting identifies China Telecom Cloud Computing Information Park as a landed Hohhot/Horinger data-center project; Horinger New Area had 46 data-center projects by 2025-06.

name: Agricultural Bank of China Data Center Third Division Horinger Project
notes: Cummins case study for AgBank's Horinger financial data center phase 1 states 209,000 sqm construction area and 122.4 MW installed standby generator capacity; local government news says the ABC third-division Horinger project was lit and operating.

name: Hohhot Green Grid Intelligent Computing Network Integrated AI Base
developer: Hohhot Shuzhi Industrial Development Co., Ltd.
notes: Filing reported for a RMB 300 million project in Xincheng District's Hongsheng Industrial Park using China Unicom Hohhot Cloud Data Center space; planned at no less than 300P AI compute, construction 2025-06 to 2026-06.

name: Hulunbuir Big Data Center Phase I
developer: State Grid Information & Telecommunication Group / Hulunbuir government / Huawei
notes: China Power News reported phase I in Hailar Economic and Technological Development Zone was operational, built with State Grid IT Group and Huawei, with 31,900 sqm and 2,060 standard cabinets in 10 national A-grade rooms.

name: Hailar District Big Data Center PPP Project
developer: Inner Mongolia Haiguo Huachuang Cloud Data Technology Co., Ltd.
notes: Ministry of Finance local-news item describes the Hailar District Big Data Center PPP as a RMB 468 million, 19,812 sqm data-center/cloud/big-data project supporting Hulunbuir digital economy.

name: Hulunbeier Hulun Data Technology Zhalainuoer Data Intelligent Computing Center
developer: Inner Mongolia Hulun Big Data Technology Co., Ltd.
notes: Zhalainuoer district government published a project filing notice for a local data intelligent-computing center; capacity details were not visible in the search extract, so capacity is left null.

name: Yuntai Internet Green Cloud Data Center
notes: Inner Mongolia News reported ZTE-affiliated Yuntai Internet invested RMB 1 billion in Ordos in 2011 and operated a green cloud data center scaled for 30,000 servers; Aliyun article lists it as built in Ordos cloud/base projects.

name: Ordos Big Data Center / Ordos Cloud Base
developer: Ordos municipal high-tech zone / multiple tenants
notes: Aliyun developer article describes two planned/constructed bases, Ordos High-Tech Zone Cloud Computing Industrial Park and Ordos Big Data Center, with ZTE, China Unicom and other projects built and more than 30,000 rack capacity in standardized data rooms under construction.

name: Ordos Jinyuansheng Intelligent Computing Center
notes: China High-Tech Industry Herald reported a RMB 10 billion Ordos Jinyuansheng intelligent computing center was signed in 2025; capacity details not reported in accessible extract.

name: China Telecom Inner Mongolia Tongliao Computing Center Second Hub Building
notes: Filing reported June 2026 for a RMB 119.4139 million project in Tongliao Keerqin Industrial Park, including hub building, phase-I electromechanical works, external power, conduit and fiber works; project extended to 2027-06-06.

name: Mengdong (Tongliao) Green Computing Power Industrial Parks and Computing Center Source-Grid-Load-Storage Demonstration
developer: Tongliao municipal government / future park tenants
notes: Tongliao government's green-computing plan targets Tongbei Industrial Park, the development zone and Kezuohouqi computing parks, with supporting infrastructure by 2027 and source-grid-load-storage direct green-power demonstration for computing centers by 2030; goal is 200,000P intelligent compute by 2035.

name: GDS Wulanchabu Data Center Phase I
notes: GDS official news says phase I is in Jining District Chahar Industrial Park, 125 mu, about 110,000 sqm, four standalone data-center buildings plus substation/office/generator buildings; five buildings had topped out and delivery was planned no later than 2025.

name: UCloud Wulanchabu Cloud Computing Center
notes: UCloud official page describes its first self-built/self-operated campus data center in Jining District Chahar Industrial Park, 140,000 sqm land, five data-center buildings, 10,000+ racks, and two 110 kV external power feeds totaling 200 MW.

name: Zhongjin Jingmeng Green Computing Industrial Park Phase II
developer: Zhongjin / Jingmeng Green Computing Industrial Park
notes: Filing change reported for a RMB 8.4 billion phase-II project in Chahar Industrial Park Bayin Industrial Park; planned seven computing-center buildings, 14 power-center buildings, substation and auxiliaries, with about 15,750 cabinets, construction 2024-10 to 2027-09.

name: DeepSeek 1GW AI Data Center in Ulanqab
notes: DatacenterDynamics and Bloomberg-derived reports say DeepSeek is planning a 1GW AI data center in Ulanqab, with partial capacity targeted for late 2027 or early 2028; location within Ulanqab not further specified.

name: VNET Wulanchabu Green GW-Class AIDC Super Intelligent Computing Flagship Base
notes: VNET official resource page identifies a Wulanchabu green GW-class AIDC flagship base in the local data-center cluster area with independent power substations; exact commissioning status not stated, treated as planned.

name: Xilin Gol Green Computing Data Center Projects
developer: Xilin Gol League / unnamed project developers
notes: Xilin Gol commerce bureau development note says the league has two green-computing data-center projects targeted to start construction within the year and strive for operation in 2026; names and capacities were not disclosed in the accessible page text.

name: Xianghuang Banner Cloud Computing and Big Data Project
developer: Xianghuang Banner investment-promotion project / TBD investor
notes: Xianghuang Banner government investment-promotion page describes a RMB 1 billion cloud-computing/big-data project to build enterprise/service data centers and server R&D with a stated 100,000-server scale; page lists preliminary work underway.

name: Changzhou International Data Center
developer: China Telecom Changzhou Branch / Zhonglou District
notes: Jiangsu news reported a RMB 4 billion China Telecom Changzhou IDC five-star data center project signed for Zhonglou Economic Development Zone in the East China Cloud Computing Base, planned to host more than 60,000 servers.

name: China Mobile Changzhou Data Center
developer: China Mobile Changzhou / Zhonglou Economic Development Zone
notes: Project start reported for a more than RMB 2 billion China Mobile Changzhou data center in the East China Cloud Computing Base, about 19,000 sqm, expected to provide 3,000+ racks at 5-7 kW.

name: Sino-Ocean Changzhou Zhonglou Data Center
notes: Sino-Ocean official page places the project in Changzhou Zhonglou Development Zone within the East China Cloud Computing Base, with national A-grade design, 3,000 planned cabinets, and commissioning in 2016-12.

name: Cloud Data Changzhou Data Port Computing Center
notes: Company page describes the Jiangsu Changzhou Data Port computing center with 50,000+ sqm campus, 20,000+ sqm data-center building area, and 40,000 kVA power supply capacity; listed as a major East China cloud-computing center cluster.
